observation.sentence: `GET /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}/edit`: warm median 3.8 ms over 183 requests; Response write 60 %, Handler, other work 31 %, Other filters 8 %. Median CPU 3.7 ms and 2.0 MB allocated per request.
whatToCheck: Most of the time is writing the response: check its size and any lazy loading during serialization.
Open the slowest exemplar request in Live Activity to see its timeline.
limitations: The journal evicted older events, so a route's first request may be gone and none is reported apart as cold.
